title: Microsoft Rules Out Cyberattack in Outage, Warns of Phishing Campaign
description: Microsoft experienced a technical outage affecting Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online and Outlook, which was not caused by a cyberattack. During this outage, attackers launched a phishing campaign impersonating Microsoft 365 service notifications, referencing the real outage incident and threatening to delete held emails unless recipients clicked malicious links. Microsoft identified and blocked the phishing campaign and advised organizations to verify service incidents through official channels.
